title: Worse Overall, Turned
eyebrow: CETI · the 75-second case · Simpson's paradox · the instrument
lede: A new sales process converts worse overall, so it gets killed. Berkeley, 1973 on a turntable: 4,526 applicants as boxes, men's column taller from the front, six department slabs from the side. Same boxes, different viewpoint.

commit.title: YOUR GUESS
commit.prompt: Women got in less often overall. In how many of the 6 departments did they do worse?

captions: Our new sales process converts worse overall.
So we killed it. Case closed?
Berkeley, 1973: women got in less often overall.
In how many of 6 departments did women do worse?
Fewer women got in. The headline writes itself.
Overall: 45 % of men admitted, 30 % of women.
Now turn it. Same boxes, split by department.
Same boxes, same rules. Compare each department.
Women did worse in 2 of 6, and ahead in 4.
1,385 of 2,691 men applied to A or B; 133 of 1,835 women.
Monday: did the new process get the same mix of leads?
Splitting explains this gap. It does not prove fairness.

brand.takeaway: Split by segment before you call it worse.

sources: Bickel, P. J., Hammel, E. A., & O'Connell, J. W. (1975). Sex bias in graduate admissions: Data from Berkeley. Science, 187(4175), 398–404. doi:10.1126/science.187.4175.398
R Core Team. UCBAdmissions: Student Admissions at UC Berkeley (R datasets package; 4,526 applicants, six largest departments, 1973; counts from Bickel et al. 1975).
Freedman, D., Pisani, R., & Purves, R. (2007). Statistics (4th ed.), ch. 2 §4: the six largest majors, Berkeley 1973. W. W. Norton.
Simpson, E. H. (1951). The interpretation of interaction in contingency tables. Journal of the Royal Statistical Society, Series B, 13(2), 238–241.
Pearl, J. (2014). Comment: Understanding Simpson's paradox. The American Statistician, 68(1), 8–13. doi:10.1080/00031305.2014.876829
factory/FORMAT.md and docs/DECISIONS.md Q13: the 8-second commit hold and the film-mode default guess (5).
honest: Splitting explains this gap. It does not prove fairness. The film counts the six largest departments of one year; why women applied mostly to the crowded departments is a question the split cannot answer.
Campus-wide the gap was about 44 % of 8,442 men against 35 % of 4,321 women (Bickel et al. 1975); pooled over the six departments shown it is 45 % against 30 %.
A split can mislead too: split on what came before the decision (the department, the segment), not on something the decision caused (Pearl 2014). The sales hook is a situation, not data.

knobs_doc.name: boxSize
knobs_doc.what: edge of one box in world units; with boxGap sets the pitch, so it scales the whole sculpture

knobs_doc.name: boxGap
knobs_doc.what: seam between boxes in world units; larger reads as separate applicants, smaller as a solid bar

knobs_doc.name: colW
knobs_doc.what: boxes across one pooled column (even); with colD sets the column footprint and so its height

knobs_doc.name: colD
knobs_doc.what: boxes deep in one pooled column (even)

knobs_doc.name: colGap
knobs_doc.what: boxes of air between the men and women columns (even)

knobs_doc.name: slabLayers
knobs_doc.what: layers in a department slab: the height that every slab is normalised to, so lit height reads as a rate

knobs_doc.name: slabDepth
knobs_doc.what: boxes deep in a department slab (the view axis of the side view)

knobs_doc.name: slabGap
knobs_doc.what: world units of air between department groups in the side view

knobs_doc.name: pairGap
knobs_doc.what: world units between the men's slab and the women's slab of one department

knobs_doc.name: platterR
knobs_doc.what: radius of the turntable platter ring in world units

knobs_doc.name: elev0

knobs_doc.name: elev1
knobs_doc.what: camera elevation in degrees in the side view

knobs_doc.name: zoom0
knobs_doc.what: orthographic extent multiplier for the front view (lower is closer)

knobs_doc.name: zoom1
knobs_doc.what: orthographic extent multiplier for the side view (lower is closer)

knobs_doc.name: lookY0
knobs_doc.what: world y the camera looks at in the front view (more negative moves the sculpture down the frame)

knobs_doc.name: lookY1
knobs_doc.what: world y the camera looks at in the side view

knobs_doc.name: idleDeg
